agent.problem: The detail that Mary Magdalene was one of the women who followed Jesus from Galilee comes from Matthew 27:55-56, not Matthew 28:1. The card cites only Matthew 28:1, so this outside fact does not carry its supporting reference.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards gives the baker a basis for choosing whether the angel sits, stands or kneels on the stone. All three actions are equally plausible, so the blank quizzes an unseen verb rather than a meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The wrong answer 'The people of Galilee' is arguably true as far as it goes, because Galilee is included in the commission to all nations. Unlike the explicitly exclusive 'Only the people of Israel,' this option leaves the card open to the argument that it also describes people the eleven are sent to disciple.

rule.text: No near-matches. A wrong answer never means the same as the right answer, or close to it. If a baker could argue it's right, replace it.
